channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: How US oil firms profit $130bn from Iran war as household bills surge
item.description: As energy from the Gulf and Russia take a hit, American oil and gas firms are the big gainers.

item.title: How would Tehran respond if the US and Israel bomb Iran again?
item.description: Iran has retained significant offensive capability, but civilians and critical infrastructure remain largely exposed.

item.title: Iran says US talks could resume ‘within a short period’ if demands are met
item.description: Esmaeil Baghaei said Qatar is facilitating indirect talks based on Iran’s seven-step peace plan.

item.title: Al-Jawf becomes new hotspot in Yemen war between government forces, Houthis
item.description: Recent military advances by Yemeni government forces highlight the geographic and strategic significance of Al-Jawf.

item.title: Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree
item.description: One-way drone attacks have killed or wounded 484 civilians since February, Khartoum says.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts a missile as fighting rages in Yemen’s al-Jawf
item.description: Houthi-affiliated media report that seven people were wounded in strikes on the city of Hodeidah.

item.title: Nuclear radiation in Russia, Ukraine? No, just hacked warning alerts
item.description: Warnings startle people in Ukraine, but authorities say they cleared up the confusion in under an hour.

item.title: Fake nuclear warnings issued after Ukrainian and Russian air alert apps hacked
item.description: Neither government has confirmed who was responsible for the cyberattacks on Sunday evening.

item.title: Nine killed as small jet crashes on Florida street
item.description: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground."

item.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
item.description: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.
